scope: First three-task main comparison. Seed 100 v3 shares the saved MedBook first-stage checkpoint with the GSPO-prime control, then takes 200 optimizer updates on each of PathVQA and English SLAKE. No preceding performance or multi-seed run is required.
method: FP32 selected output-head matmul, BF16 backbone. Four MedBook option rotations, PathVQA yes/no only. Anchored loss beta*softplus((max(0.5*initial_margin,0.5)-margin)/beta). Each step selects one old task by round robin and eight views, partitioned across two ranks, and combines the conflict-projected RL gradient and weighted memory gradient before the shared optimizer clips and steps.
fisher_calibration_precision: The saved GSPO-prime endpoint is BF16. BF16 rounding can inflate calibration energy and reduce gamma relative to FP32 master-to-master calibration. All seeds reuse the same measured gamma.
audit_guard: New references are selected and immediately re-scored on the actual training stack, before the first update of each stage. Any newly anchored flip aborts. Previously anchored views remain fixed and any inherited flips are reported and used by the dual controller.
evaluation: All learned tasks on their frozen validation splits. MedBook semantic probe uses four orders even for comparators, PathVQA semantic probe uses fixed binary answers. Candidate pools have 338 rows each. Outside-memory probes exclude all pool candidates and consist of previously trained rows. PathVQA validation reports binary balanced accuracy, predicted yes fraction, and deterministic full exact-match. Test data stay sealed.
first_round_gate: Use the single-GPU seed-100 no-memory control. Repeat v3 only if its common-eligible unreplayed flip rate is at most 0.6 times a positive baseline rate and its PathVQA acquisition accuracy is at least the control's. Otherwise the next candidate is seed-100 R1+C3, after the actual-model memory check. Report measurable baseline forgetting separately.
